title: Unknown error-code literal
description: Numeric literals compared with Get(LastError) that the FileMaker error-code table does not list (fm_spec error_codes, fm-spec 2.8.0+; ranges such as 1552-1559 and 5000-5499 count as covered). Every spelling of Get(LastError) the reference knows is matched (11 locales); Case/Choose forms and reversed comparisons are out of scope by design.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A comparison against an undocumented code never matches a FileMaker error - the branch is dead unless a plug-in or a custom Revert Transaction code delivers it.
rule.remediation: Check the code against the FileMaker error-code reference (fm-spec error_codes / Claris help); custom codes belong in 5000-5499, plug-in codes in 1552-1559.

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Comparisons of Get(LastError) with a code the FileMaker error-code table does not list

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).
